reason: parseFrontmatter throws YAMLParseError on malformed YAML frontmatter and has no non-throwing form. Returning undefined skips a single corrupt agent file instead of crashing discovery of all valid and built-in subagents.

readdirSync and statSync throw EACCES/ENOENT on unreadable or vanished agent directories. Returning an empty list skips the unreadable directory instead of crashing discovery of other directories and built-in subagents.
